scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:css && pnpm run lint:config && pnpm run test
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter client test:e2e && pnpm run vrt && pnpm --filter ops run smoke
scripts.vrt: pnpm --filter client run build-storybook && docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e HOME=/tmp mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble node_modules/.bin/playwright test -c packages/client/test/vrt/vrt.config.ts
scripts.vrt:update: pnpm --filter client run build-storybook && docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e HOME=/tmp mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble node_modules/.bin/playwright test -c packages/client/test/vrt/vrt.config.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.lint:config: ! grep -rl '"paths"' tsconfig.base.json packages/*/tsconfig.json || (echo 'tsconfig paths 별칭을 쓰지 않습니다 — package.json의 imports 필드를 쓰세요 (ADR 0012)' && exit 1)
scripts.build: pnpm --filter client build && pnpm --filter server build
